## Customer research,

## streamlined

Go from first question to comprehensive report in hours, not weeks.

Create your study

01

Our AI helps you go from idea to implemented discussion guide in seconds.

Listen recruits participants

02

Listen finds and qualifies the right participants in our global network of 30M+ people.

AI-moderated interviews

03

Listen conducts an in-depth interview with the participant, asks follow up questions and understands the full context.

Results delivered overnight

04

Listen packages insights in an executive-ready report including key themes, highlight reels, and even slide decks.

## The AI-first research platform

Replace manual research methods with AI-moderated customer interviews.

AI-moderated interviews

Probe deeper with an AI interviewer that conducts personalized interviews with each customer, at scale.

Actionable results, instantly

Generate key takeaways, personas, and reveal top themes. Automatically.

Recruit participants

Use our pool of millions of participants (B2B and B2C), integrate with your provider, or recruit your own.

Any language

Translate and transcribe automatically between more than 100 languages.

Test any stimuli

Videos, images or Figma prototypes - we handle all types of stimuli.

Video, audio, or text

Engage with customers through video recordings, audio chats, or text.
